plugins.name: agent-comms
plugins.description: Main/subagent real-time comms for ZCode: bundled worker agent type with a three-boundary reporting protocol, plus report/wait_worker_event/read_events MCP tools (wait-any-worker, silence detection, auditable anchor artifacts).

description_i18n.en: Real-time main/subagent communication: bundled worker type with reporting protocol baked into its system prompt, plus wait-any-worker MCP tool with timeout summaries.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 主/子代理实时互通：worker 类型自带三层边界汇报协议（随系统提示词注入），配套 report/wait_worker_event/read_events 工具实现任意 worker 聚合等待、沉默检测与锚工件审计。
